title: Foot surgery refusal
summary: He lacks capacity and refuses surgery for a foot infection antibiotics are unlikely to control.

title: Suicide hold
summary: A capacitated man asks to leave after a suicide attempt, and a hold would delay other patients.

title: ApoE result
summary: She leaves tomorrow wanting an Alzheimer-risk result that counseling cannot explain in time.

title: HIV partner notice
summary: He leaves tomorrow with new HIV and refuses any help notifying his partners.

title: Parents refuse blood
summary: His parents refuse blood during urgent brain surgery, and it is unclear he shares their faith.

title: Chest pain protocol
summary: Chest tightness has eased at shift change, and a protocol would take a scarce monitored bed.

title: Newborn screening
summary: Parents refuse newborn sickle cell screening, and the sample must leave before the next pickup.

title: No parent consent
summary: Her wrist fracture needs reduction tonight, and no parent can consent for anesthesia.

title: Dialysis capacity
summary: She may lack capacity, and without dialysis she could die of high potassium within days.

title: Ear surgery request
summary: His parents want surgery for ears that draw teasing, and the referral must be made or deferred today.

title: BRCA embryo screening
summary: They want embryo screening for a BRCA variant the public insurer does not usually cover.

title: Mastectomy only
summary: She will accept only a high-risk mastectomy, not the safer lumpectomy that would spare the ICU.

title: Uncertain chemo
summary: She wants chemotherapy whose benefit is uncertain and that may cost her remaining alert time.

title: Surgery, past wishes
summary: She may have a repairable perforation, and her children say she rejected lasting machine dependence.

title: Preemie central line
summary: A stable premature newborn must get a new central line or be extubated for comfort care.

title: Last covered cycle
summary: She wants to trigger ovulation despite several follicles, and this is her last covered cycle.

title: Aid in dying
summary: If aid in dying is declined, his hands may fail before he can see another physician.

title: Duty to warn
summary: He reports persistent thoughts of killing a former partner, and he will leave today.

title: Amputation refusal
summary: He refuses amputation for a spreading foot infection, and his capacity is in dispute.

title: Cancer diagnosis
summary: He wants the cancer diagnosis today, and disclosure may set off another dangerous panic attack.

title: Measles exposure
summary: An unvaccinated toddler will return to a classroom where measles exposure is still being investigated.

title: Twin pregnancy risk
summary: Both embryos must be used or discarded today, and twins could threaten her kidney transplant.

title: Trach or comfort
summary: He has not woken after ten days on a ventilator, and the next step is a tracheostomy or comfort care.

title: Surrogate choice
summary: She needs one surrogate now, and there is a documented concern of violence by her husband.

title: Brief ICU trial
summary: She agreed to a brief ICU trial if the illness was reversible, and she can no longer confirm it.

title: Scarce dialysis slot
summary: He is dying of AIDS with kidney failure, and the dialysis slot closes unless it starts now.

title: Hidden HIV status
summary: She is pregnant with a detectable viral load and fears harm if her partner learns she has HIV.

title: Teen Huntington test
summary: If this 15-year-old is not tested for Huntington disease now, she may wait another year.

title: Refuses admission
summary: He refuses admission for treatable hydrocephalus, and he may not grasp the risk of that refusal.

title: Flu shot refusal
summary: She refuses a flu shot and still wants clearance for a unit full of high-risk patients.

title: Double mastectomy
summary: She wants both breasts removed because fear is making her skip screening, and her risk is uncertain.

title: Pregnant, brain-dead
summary: She is brain-dead and pregnant, and machines cannot help her but might carry the pregnancy.

title: Organ donor delay
summary: He is brain-dead and a registered donor, and his parents ask to wait until tomorrow.

title: Shorter leukemia plan
summary: She was assigned three years of leukemia treatment and now wants the two-year plan instead.

title: Refuses HIV labs
summary: She refuses HIV staging labs unless the visit explains today how serious the illness may be.

title: Fluids or restraints
summary: He has barely drunk in two days, and IV fluids would mean restraints on a psychiatry ward.

title: Refuses hospital care
summary: She has ongoing suicidal thoughts, refuses hospital care, and a hold is optional while risk is unclear.

title: Duplicate vaccines
summary: A chart error suggests duplicate vaccines, and her anxious mother will not be called until tomorrow.

title: Paranoid traits note
summary: She insists on reading a note about paranoid traits alone before she leaves.

title: Weight counseling
summary: He panics when weight comes up, and his mother wants diet counseling before the visit ends.

title: Split opinions
summary: Consultants disagree about whether more treatment could help, and the committee meets in two days.

title: No terminal illness
summary: He has no terminal illness, he has capacity, and he wants assisted dying started this week.

title: Guardian decides
summary: His guardian must accept or refuse induction for leukemia that is unlikely to cure him.

title: Lip repair tonight
summary: A child's lip must be repaired tonight, and waiting for plastics would let swelling blur the border.

title: Advance decision
summary: Her advance decision refuses ICU ventilation, but it may not cover a reversible overdose.

title: Kidney donor pressure
summary: He says the kidney donation is voluntary, and his family warns his community is pressuring him.

title: Feeding tube
summary: He refused tubes and restraints, and a feeding tube would likely require both.

title: Donor, parents object
summary: He is a registered donor, his parents object, and waiting past tonight would waste the organs.

title: Ran toward traffic
summary: He has already run toward traffic, and observation may not legally stop him leaving again.

title: Pregnancy deadline
summary: They may end the pregnancy if the fetus is unaffected, and a transfer would miss the legal deadline.
